raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-KHM-BasicEducationImprovement",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Climate‑related floods, cyclones and extreme heat may damage school facilities and cause prolonged closures.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate‑resilient construction standards, include flood‑elevated foundations, install emergency shelters, and activate CERC when needed.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 12: floods, cyclones and extreme heat cause school closures and damage."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Overcrowded classrooms ( >30 pupils) reduce learning effectiveness.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Build additional classrooms per subcomponent 2.3, enforce maximum class‑size caps, and monitor student‑teacher ratios.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 37: 76% of primary students in classes >30 pupils, indicating overcrowding."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Insufficient teacher capacity and limited professional development hinder instructional quality.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Scale CPD, mentoring, career pathways, recruit additional teachers, and implement teacher performance monitoring.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 9 lists insufficient teacher capacity as a principal cause of poor outcomes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Procurement delays and corruption risk due to limited staff knowledge of World Bank regulations.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Assign full‑time procurement officer, provide World Bank procurement training, publish procurement plans, and establish a complaint mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 68‑70: limited procurement knowledge, corruption risk, and inadequate contract supervision identified."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Financial‑management staff overload may cause transaction processing delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Hire additional FM staff within three months, set processing‑time targets, and monitor workload regularly.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 63(a): FM staff may be overloaded, causing processing delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Delayed approval of the Annual Work Plan and Budget could stall project activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set firm AWPB submission deadlines, require senior sign‑off, and track approval status monthly.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 63(b): delayed AWPB approval may hinder timely implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "School mentoring funding may not be properly monitored, risking misuse.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement detailed mentoring‑fund tracking system, conduct quarterly audits, and require regular school reporting.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 63(c): risk school mentoring funding may not be properly monitored."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Limited evidence on TaRL pilot may impede successful scale‑up of targeted instruction.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Pilot TaRL in limited schools, monitor rigorously, adjust design based on results, and allocate contingency budget for scale‑up.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 36: TaRL pilot limited evidence for scale‑up, increasing uncertainty."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Dependence on donor partners for EGL and TaRL could create funding gaps after 2027.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage donors early for follow‑on financing, embed activities in MoEYS budget, and develop a sustainability plan.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 21‑22: DP support expected to phase out by 2027, creating funding gaps."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Gender‑based violence (GBV) data gaps may limit effective prevention and response measures.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen GBV monitoring, integrate GBV indicators, train teachers on GBV response, and coordinate with GEIP GBV team.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 57‑58: GBV data gaps noted; BEIP will build on GEIP GBV mechanisms."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "New school buildings may fail to meet universal design standards, limiting accessibility for children with disabilities.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce universal‑design checklist, conduct accessibility audits, produce braille materials, and monitor compliance.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 59: new buildings must meet universal design; braille materials planned."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "ICT equipment may malfunction under extreme temperature and humidity, disrupting e‑learning.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure climate‑rated hardware, store devices in climate‑controlled rooms, and schedule regular maintenance.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 62: ICT equipment must withstand extreme temperature and humidity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "M&E data quality risk due to reliance on multiple sources and limited PMU capacity.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade PMU data‑management capacity, adopt digital M&E tools, and conduct periodic data‑quality assessments.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 50: M&E relies on multiple data sources; PMU oversees coordination."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Land acquisition and involuntary resettlement may arise for new school construction, triggering social conflict.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct ESIA, develop a resettlement action plan, ensure fair compensation, and engage affected communities per ESS 5.",
      "evidence": "ESS 5 listed as relevant, indicating land acquisition/resettlement risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Cash‑flow uncertainty due to variable Designated Account ceiling and quarterly disbursement schedule.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Maintain a cash buffer, align disbursement schedule with procurement plan, and monitor DA ceiling quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 52: DA ceiling equals two‑quarter cash forecast, creating cash‑flow uncertainty."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Inadequate capacity for contract supervision may cause implementation delays and quality issues.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Designate contract supervisors, provide supervision training, conduct regular performance reviews, and use third‑party audits.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 68(e): inadequate capacity for contract supervision may cause delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Insufficient integration of climate‑resilient standards for infrastructure and ICT could reduce overall project resilience.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate‑resilient design to all new buildings, perform climate risk assessments for ICT, and update designs as needed.",
      "evidence": "Paragraph 61‑62: climate‑resilient designs and ICT climate‑proofing integrated."
    }
  ]
}
